title: DlpPolicyInput
description: Body of POST /dlp-policies and PUT /dlp-policies/{policyId} (PUT replaces the whole policy). Send the payload key that belongs to detector; a key for another detector is a 422. project_id absent = null on PUT; enabled absent = true on create, unchanged on PUT. Unknown keys are a 422.

project_id.description: Scope: a project in this workspace, or null for every project in the workspace (workspace and project policies compose: a request is matched by both). Must belong to the workspace.

slug.description: Unique in the workspace; the policy’s identifier in a trace’s dlp_matched_policies. Changing it renames that identifier.

detector.description: Selects which one of pattern, presets, keywords or secrets carries the payload. Changing it means sending the new payload key.

pattern.description: RE2 regular expression (not PCRE: no lookarounds or backreferences). Only when detector is regex.

presets.description: Managed preset ids (e.g. email, credit_card). Only when detector is preset.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings; no commas, no leading or trailing whitespace. Only when detector is keyword.

secrets.description: Secret-scanner ids (e.g. adobe-client-id, 1password-secret-key). Only when detector is secret.

action.description: tokenize needs the plan that includes it; otherwise 422 on action.

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

workspace_id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

created_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.

updated_at.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
